notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l001: Continues preceding1649:42 courageous warriors. Repeated still more enumeration preserved, not deduplicated.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l005: Men thrash like a bereaved wife; source gendered simile retained, not actual wife in battle.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l013: Biting through tongue distinguished lips28; hyperbole retained, not silently substituted lip.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l017: Каканчы collective imperial Chinese people here per Yudakhin/Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/КАКАН/, not separate emperor in plural group list.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l018: Sucking dry image menace to opponent inferred, no vampire identity invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l020: Tail knots refer mounts, not men tails.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l029: Eyes seething on far/inner side construed deep-set fierce gaze; precise anatomy or inverted face not invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l031: Never sated with humans contextual cannibalistic epithet; no number supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l032: Ajgu and Jajojo retained as printed coordinated proper names; possible Gog/Magog relation not substituted without evidence.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l036: Бээлесең = attentive consideration: Yudakhin бээле-=бейле- https://el-sozduk.kg/бээ/ and бейле attentively observe/consider https://el-sozduk.kg/бей/ lines1941–1952. Muslims object of following capture clause, not rule-your-Muslims.
notes.manas-2010:p1650:b001:l039: Earth turns/splits epic crowd image, no scientific earthquake asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l006: Almambet addressed as protective spear-banner, not new actual banner possession.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l009: Golden iron armor image retained, not metallurgical alloy specified.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l015: Oiled wheat complexion image literal, not invented cosmetics.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l024: Willing sacrifice of life conditional God wills, not suicide instruction or confirmed death; repeated27–28 retained.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l025: Prophet not treading Beijing epic formula, no historical claim inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l029: Stake-necked horse epithet preserves stiff/straight neck image.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l031: Lean-haunched уй куймулчак racehorse term, not cow anatomy.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l035: Zulpuqor named sword; double-edged explicitly preserved, not automatically split blade.
notes.manas-2010:p1651:b001:l037: Yesterday planted willow and golden throne left behind illustrate abandoned possessions; actual sequence/date not reconciled. Willow not silently converted to spear shaft.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l005: Gun taken as gift from Beijing; giver not specified in this clause.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l006: көйкашка renowned distinguished per exact Yudakhin variant https://el-sozduk.kg/koy-12/, not shameless.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l009: Moonlike shoulder mirror weapon gleam image retained, not literal glass accessory.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l012: очогор matchlock verified earlier Yudakhin/2015 wick mechanism; not flintlock. Play versus earnest rhetorical prowess contrast, not toy weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l017: кой көз brown-eye idiom and no pale flecks чекир separately represented; not sheep eyes literal animal transplant.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l023: Teeth broad as door crumble like millet from wrath; epic bodily hyperbole kept rather than claiming merely grinding.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l024: Handful of Muslims restored within its own English verse, question continues25; revised pair reread.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l026: айла means/resourcefulness rendered find a way, not brute strength; final revision reread.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l028: алты сан can mean entirety (2015phraseology https://el-sozduk.kg/alty-san/); сан II can also myriad/ten thousand (Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/?lfrom=ru&lto=xx&page=main&word=САН). Six myriad retains epic numerical surface provisionally, not certified army census.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l034: Blood enters/stirs battle ardor idiom not transfusion.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l036: үзүк yurt roof felt size comparison of Shuutu cap, no literal yurt worn.
notes.manas-2010:p1652:b001:l041: Exact Yudakhin quote кан төк десе жин төккөн https://el-sozduk.kg/жин/ means excessive zeal; жин II stomach contents, not demon or bowel organs. Final English corrected from guts to stomach contents and reread; parallel literal excess poison/water and head/cap retained.
